resources.string: CrookCatcher uses the accessibility permission for certain safety features that users can turn on if desired. They include turning off the screen when the power menu, notification shade or quick settings are shown on the lockscreen. The purpose of this is to prevent thieves from turning off the device or switching on airplane mode.
The accessibility permission is needed to detect when the power menu, notification shade or quick tiles are shown on the screen.

"CrookCatcher does not collect any personal or sensitive data, nor does it track your activity outside of the app. Anonymous usage statistics about the the experimental features are collected to improve their stability and performance. This can be turned off by disabling the 'Improve CrookCatcher' setting on the main settings screen."
To enable this feature, CrookCatcher requires the accessibility permission.

"To continue, please follow these steps:

3) Once enabled, press back until you return to CrookCatcher."
